title: Group similar proteins across five Hepatoplasmataceae genomes
summary: Run LOSATP in the browser, assign CDS-derived proteins to gbdraw similarity groups, and draw links between group members in five Hepatoplasmataceae genomes.

manualSteps.title: Switch to Linear mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and select Linear mode before adding inputs.

manualSteps.title: Upload the five GenBank files
manualSteps.body: Keep the records in the same order as the Gallery command so adjacent comparison tracks match the published example.

media.alt: AP027078.gb File card with its Organism / strain and Subtitle / title fields, and Record options open to the region controls.
media.caption: Upload AP027078.gb, open Record options if region settings are needed, and repeat the remaining files in table order.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; const expected = ['AP027078.gb', 'AP027131.gb', 'AP027133.gb', 'AP027132.gb', 'NZ_CP006932.gb']; const names = (app?.linearSeqs || []).map((seq) => seq.gb?.name || ''); if (JSON.stringify(names) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) throw new Error('Hepatoplasmataceae GenBank order was not restored.'); const row = document.querySelector('[data-linear-record-card="record-1"]'); const options = row?.querySelector('[data-linear-record-options="record-1"]'); if (!row || !options) throw new Error('Hepatoplasmataceae Linear input row 1 was not found.'); options.open = true; const fileCard = row.closest('[data-linear-source-card]'); if (!fileCard) throw new Error('Linear file card was not found.'); fileCard.dataset.capture = 'hepatoplasmataceae-record-row'; fileCard.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Use browser LOSAT
manualSteps.body: In Comparison, choose Run LOSAT. Open Settings when you need to review the browser runtime controls under Performance.

rows: Auto for routine runs, or 32 when you need to mirror the saved CLI command

media.alt: Comparison card with Run LOSAT pressed, closed Settings, and Selected pairs 4.
media.caption: Choose Run LOSAT for all four adjacent comparisons; the pressed command confirms it.

actions.script: async () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; await app.setLinearComparisonGlobalAction('losat'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatMode('blastp'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatpMode('orthogroup'); }

media.alt: Performance controls showing Auto execution, Safe total threads, and automatic run allocation.
media.caption: Open Comparison › Settings to review the execution and thread allocation used by browser LOSAT.

actions.script: async () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; await app.setLinearComparisonGlobalAction('losat'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatMode('blastp'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatpMode('orthogroup'); app.losatExecution.executionMode = 'auto'; app.losatExecution.totalThreadBudget = 'safe'; app.losatExecution.parallelWorkers = undefined; app.losatExecution.threadsPerJob = 'auto'; }

const section = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-linear-comparison-disclosure="settings"][open] section')).find((node) => node.textContent.includes('Performance')); if (!section) throw new Error('Performance section was not found.'); section.dataset.capture = 'hep-orthogroup-runtime'; section.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Select Similarity groups
manualSteps.body: Use Similarity groups to draw links between proteins assigned to the same gbdraw visualization group rather than combining anchors into collinear blocks.
manualSteps.note: gbdraw builds its similarity groups from searches across all record pairs, then draws links between adjacent displayed records. These groups support visualization but are not phylogeny-based orthology assignments. The companion collinear tutorial combines compatible runs of the same protein-match anchors into collinear blocks.

operations.title: Similarity groups mode controls
operations.body: Open Settings, set LOSAT Mode to LOSATP, then open LOSATP mode and choose Similarity groups.

media.alt: Comparison Settings showing all three LOSAT Mode buttons with LOSATP pressed and the LOSATP mode menu open with Similarity groups highlighted.
media.caption: Press LOSATP, then open LOSATP mode and choose the highlighted Similarity groups option.

actions.script: async () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; await app.setLinearComparisonGlobalAction('losat'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatMode('blastp'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatpMode('orthogroup'); }

operations.title: Similarity-group threshold settings
operations.body: Use the LOSATP threshold values in the table.

media.alt: Open Comparison Settings with the LOSATP button pressed, Similarity groups selected, and the four result filter controls.
media.caption: Press LOSATP, select Similarity groups, and set Bitscore to 50, E-value to 1e-2, Min identity (%) to 0, and Min length to 0.

actions.script: async () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; await app.setLinearComparisonGlobalAction('losat'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatMode('blastp'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatpMode('orthogroup'); app.adv.min_bitscore = 50; app.adv.evalue = '1e-2'; app.adv.identity = 0; app.adv.alignment_length = 0; }

manualSteps.title: Set the diagram layout
manualSteps.body: Use the ajisai palette, the Features on axis track layout, and a ruler. Center the records, separate the strands, and show GC content and GC skew.

operations.title: Scale style selector
operations.body: Open Scale Style and choose Ruler.

media.alt: Axis and Scale card with Show Coordinate Scale selected and the Scale Style menu open on Ruler.
media.caption: Leave Show Coordinate Scale selected and choose Ruler (Ticks) for Scale Style.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.form.show_scale = true; app.form.scale_style = 'ruler';

media.alt: Layout card with the Features on axis track layout and the center alignment, separate strands, GC content, and GC skew options selected.
media.caption: Set Track Layout to Features on axis and select Align to Center, Separate Strands, Show GC Content, and Show GC Skew.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const section = document.querySelector("[data-setting='layout']"); const summary = section?.querySelector(':scope > details > summary'); const track = section?.querySelector('div:has(> #linear-track-layout)'); const options = section?.querySelector('[data-layout-options]'); if (!app || !summary || !track || !options) throw new Error('Layout controls are unavailable.'); const matches = app.form?.linear_track_layout === 'middle' && app.form?.align_center === true && app.form?.separate_strands === true && app.form?.show_gc === true && app.form?.show_skew === true && app.adv?.pairwise_match_style === 'curve' && String(app.selectedPalette || '') === 'ajisai'; if (!matches) throw new Error('Restored layout settings do not match the tutorial.'); track.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Generate and inspect the similarity-group overview
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. The first LOSATP search can take time; later runs reuse its results when the input files and LOSAT settings have not changed. The preview should show individual green similarity-group ribbons instead of larger orientation-colored collinear blocks.

media.alt: Generated five-genome Hepatoplasmataceae preview with dense green similarity-group ribbons, GC content and skew tracks, a ruler, and the legend.
media.caption: The generated preview shows five genome records connected by dense green similarity-group ribbons.

manualSteps.title: Open a similarity-group match popup
manualSteps.body: Click a pairwise ribbon in the interactive SVG to inspect the gbdraw group ID, display name, and the count of genes and records. The table below lists the member proteins.

media.alt: Zoomed Hepatoplasmataceae similarity-group crop with the highlighted match ribbon and popup.
media.caption: The highlighted og_244 ribbon remains visible beside its popup: rpsK, 5 genes in 5 records, and the first rows of the 30S ribosomal protein S11 member table.

actions.script: document.querySelector('.preview-feature-search')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.preview-controls')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('footer')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; if (!app?.svgContainer || !document.querySelector("[data-gbdraw-match-id='comparison1_match331']")) throw new Error('Similarity-group target is unavailable.'); app.resultPanelTab = 'preview'; app.zoom = 1.15; if (app.canvasPan) { app.canvasPan.x = -970; app.canvasPan.y = 0; }

const target = document.querySelector("[data-gbdraw-match-id='comparison1_match331']"); const rect = target?.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!target || !rect) throw new Error('Similarity-group click target is unavailable.'); target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: rect.left + rect.width / 2, clientY: rect.top + rect.height / 2, view: window }));

const popup = document.querySelector('.pairwise-match-popup'); const target = document.querySelector("[data-gbdraw-match-id='comparison1_match331']"); const text = String(popup?.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase(); const rect = target?.getBoundingClientRect(); for (const expected of ['og_244', '30s ribosomal protein s11', 'genes in', 'ap027078.1']) { if (!text.includes(expected)) throw new Error(`Similarity-group popup is missing: ${expected}`); } if (!rect || !popup) throw new Error('Similarity-group target bounds are unavailable.'); popup.style.width = '600px'; const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; if (app?.clickedPairwiseMatchPos) { const rightX = rect.right + 24; app.clickedPairwiseMatchPos.x = rightX + 600 <= window.innerWidth - 12 ? rightX : Math.max(12, rect.left - 624); app.clickedPairwiseMatchPos.y = Math.max(24, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 500, rect.top - 80)); }

const popup = document.querySelector('.pairwise-match-popup'); const count = popup?.querySelector('[data-match-group-count]'); const rows = Array.from(popup?.querySelectorAll('[data-match-group] tbody tr') || []); const lastShown = rows[Math.min(rows.length, 4) - 1]?.querySelector('td'); if (!popup || !count || !lastShown) throw new Error('Compact similarity-group member table not found.'); popup.querySelector('[data-popup-header]').setAttribute('data-capture', 'hepat-og-popup-header'); count.setAttribute('data-capture', 'hepat-og-popup-count'); lastShown.setAttribute('data-capture', 'hepat-og-popup-member-row'); document.activeElement?.blur();

postGenerationEdits.title: Inspect a CDS feature
postGenerationEdits.body: Click the DnaA CDS and open Details to inspect its feature type, length, and protein ID. The popup header gives the label, record ID, and location.

media.alt: Highlighted DnaA CDS beside a Details popup with the AP027078.1 record ID and location in its header, then the feature type, length, and protein ID.
media.caption: The Details tab lists the feature type, length, and protein ID of the DnaA CDS in AP027078.1.

actions.script: document.querySelector('.preview-feature-search')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.preview-controls')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('footer')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; if (!app?.svgContainer || !document.querySelector('[data-gbdraw-stable-feature-id=fe826bac7]')) throw new Error('DnaA feature target is unavailable.'); app.resultPanelTab = 'preview'; app.zoom = 1.15; if (app.canvasPan) { app.canvasPan.x = 240; app.canvasPan.y = 10; }

const popup = document.querySelector('.feature-popup'); const target = document.querySelector("[data-gbdraw-stable-feature-id='fe826bac7']"); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; if (!popup || !target) throw new Error('DnaA popup bounds are unavailable.'); popup.style.width = '600px'; if (app?.clickedFeature) app.clickedFeature.activeTab = 'details'; if (app?.clickedFeaturePos) { app.clickedFeaturePos.x = 12; app.clickedFeaturePos.y = 185; }

const popup = document.querySelector('.feature-popup'); const text = String(popup?.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase(); for (const expected of ['chromosomal replication initiator protein dnaa', 'ap027078.1', 'cds', '101..1,513 (+)', 'bdu67348.1']) { if (!text.includes(expected)) throw new Error(`Feature popup is missing: ${expected}`); } const details = popup?.querySelector('[data-feature-popup-details]'); if (!details) throw new Error('DnaA detail list not found.'); popup.querySelector('[data-popup-header]').setAttribute('data-capture', 'dnaa-popup-header'); popup.querySelector('[data-feature-popup-tabs]').setAttribute('data-capture', 'dnaa-popup-tabs'); details.setAttribute('data-capture', 'dnaa-popup-details'); document.activeElement?.blur();

losatTips.title: Start with Auto execution
losatTips.body: Auto uses threaded LOSAT only when the browser supports it and the workload justifies it.

losatTips.title: Prefer Safe total threads
losatTips.body: Safe leaves some logical CPUs unused so the browser can remain responsive.

losatTips.title: Keep Threads per run on Auto
losatTips.body: Auto lets the app balance parallel pair runs and per-run LOSATP threads from the selected total thread budget.

losatTips.title: Use Serial when the browser is constrained
losatTips.body: If threaded execution is unavailable or the tab becomes unresponsive, switch Execution to Serial or lower the thread budget.

losatTips.title: Reuse the cache
losatTips.body: The app reuses LOSAT results when the input files and LOSAT settings have not changed, so styling edits avoid another search.

troubleshooting.title: Threaded LOSAT is unavailable
troubleshooting.body: Use Auto or Serial execution. Some browser contexts disable SharedArrayBuffer or cross-origin isolation, which prevents threaded WebAssembly.

troubleshooting.title: The first run is slow
troubleshooting.body: LOSATP processes five genomes in the browser. Wait for the first cache entry before making styling-only changes.

troubleshooting.title: The output is too dense
troubleshooting.body: Raise the identity, bit score, or match-length threshold, lower the E-value cutoff, or use the collinear tutorial when you want block-level summaries.

troubleshooting.title: The generated diagram differs from the Gallery image
troubleshooting.body: Check input order, LOSAT Mode LOSATP, LOSATP mode Similarity groups, Align to Center, Separate Strands, Show GC Content, and Show GC Skew.
